title: 3 Nights of Spring Break Stories
subtitle: Three nights before school starts
description: Wire up a 3-night cron that generates one illustrated bedtime chapter each evening — your kids as the heroes — and delivers it to Telegram at 8 PM. Spring break ends April 11.
action_message: Set up a 3-night bedtime story cron for the remaining nights of spring break (ending April 11). Generate one illustrated chapter each evening featuring Eliza, Icee, and Ballerina as characters. Deliver the story text to Telegram at 8 PM PT each night (tonight April 8, tomorrow April 9, and April 10). Each story should be 400–600 words, illustrated with a vivid scene description, and feel like a real bedtime story — not a summary.
